practitionerExperience.text: Ramya Amballa spent thirteen years across PwC, Wells Fargo, JPMorgan Chase and Viatris, running enterprise technology risk, cyber risk, GRC, third-party risk and audit readiness programmes across banking, professional services and life sciences.
At PwC, she tested controls across 300+ business-critical applications and cut residual risk exposure by 35% in a single programme.

At Wells Fargo and Viatris, she ran third-party risk governance for hundreds of vendor relationships end-to-end, including the part of the relationship most programmes stop watching once onboarding is signed off.
At JPMorgan Chase, she ran global KYC and sanctions operations across multiple jurisdictions.
She holds NIST AI RMF, CAISR, EU GDPR Practitioner, and Microsoft AI Transformation Leader certifications.
She has advised across Government & Public Sector, Energy & Critical Infrastructure, Financial Services and Enterprise SaaS environments.
